prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE collectible souvenir sticker for the cozy fantasy browser game 'Le monde tient dans une valise'. Square composition. A polished hand-painted 2D cartoon storybook object, rounded simple silhouette, warm dark-brown outlines, broad flat color areas with restrained soft shading and gentle cream highlights. Match a warm illustrated travel journal, not photorealistic, not 3D, not pixel art. The object is a die-cut paper sticker with a clearly visible even warm-cream border following the exact object silhouette. One object only, centered and large, with 10% transparent padding on all sides. Readable at 80 to 140 pixels in game: few large details, no tiny decorative ornaments. Actual transparent alpha background outside the sticker border, no colored square, no scene, no checkerboard drawn into the art, no cast shadow outside the border. No text, letters, numerals, logos, or watermark. Subject: a magical seashell brought back from the Azure Archipelago. One plump spiral conch shell lying diagonally, wide open lip facing the viewer, coral-peach and creamy sand on the outside, an enchanting turquoise-blue ocean glow visible inside the opening, expressed as two simple curved wave shapes contained entirely inside the shell. Friendly rounded proportions. The shell itself is the souvenir: no island, no palm tree, no background water, no separate decorative objects.
